responsibility: Provides the non-generated preamble, helpers, and public simplification glue for the autogenerated GIMPLE matcher implementation. It defines support routines for valueization, operand/type compatibility checks, conditional-operation rewriting to IFN_COND or VEC_COND forms, canonicalization policy queries, and statement-to-match-op extraction/resimplification, forming the handwritten runtime substrate that gimple-match generated patterns use to fold and canonicalize GIMPLE assignments, calls, and conditions.
